title: Lớp 7 — Phiếu Ôn Giữa Học Kỳ I Săn Điểm 8–10 (40 Câu Phân Hóa)

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose final -ed ending is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: visited ends in /ɪd/; the others end in /t/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word whose underlined letter f is pronounced differently.
questions.explanation_vi: The f in of is pronounced /v/; elsewhere /f/.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different primary stress.
questions.explanation_vi: hobby has first-syllable stress; the others have second-syllable stress.

questions.stem_text: Choose the word with a different primary stress.
questions.explanation_vi: exercise is stressed on the first syllable; the others on the second.

questions.stem_text: Linh is interested in ______ handmade cards for her friends.
questions.explanation_vi: interested in + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: My father ______ stamps when he was a teenager, but he no longer does.
questions.explanation_vi: A completed past habit takes the past simple.

questions.stem_text: If you have a sore throat, you should avoid ______ very cold drinks.
questions.explanation_vi: avoid + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: We wanted to help the neighbourhood, ______ we joined a clean-up event.
questions.explanation_vi: so introduces the result.

questions.stem_text: My brother enjoys swimming, ______ I prefer cycling.
questions.explanation_vi: but contrasts two preferences.

questions.stem_text: How often ______ your sister ______ to the sports centre?
questions.explanation_vi: Present simple questions use does + bare infinitive.

questions.stem_text: Last Saturday, our club ______ old books and ______ them to younger pupils.
questions.explanation_vi: Parallel actions in the past simple.

questions.stem_text: The teacher suggested ______ a reading corner in our classroom.
questions.explanation_vi: suggest + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: Mai: “I have planted ten trees with my class.” Hoa: “______”
questions.explanation_vi: An appropriate positive response to good news.

questions.stem_text: The students used the money from the fair to buy school ______ for children in need.
questions.explanation_vi: School supplies are items needed for learning.

questions.stem_text: You should ______ enough water, especially after playing sports.
questions.explanation_vi: The correct collocation is drink water.

questions.stem_text: My sister spends half an hour ______ the guitar every evening.
questions.explanation_vi: spend time + V-ing.

questions.stem_text: My friends and I ______ an animal shelter two weeks ago.
questions.explanation_vi: two weeks ago indicates the past simple.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: He is keen on collecting coins.
We go to the park yesterday.
written_answers: He is keen on collecting coins.
questions.explanation_vi: keen on + V-ing; the other sentences contain verb-form errors.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (19).
questions.explanation_vi: to + base verb.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (20).
questions.explanation_vi: because explains the reason.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (21).
questions.explanation_vi: A linking verb takes the adjective healthy.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (22).
questions.explanation_vi: Last month calls for the past simple.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (23).
questions.explanation_vi: A past action: arranged.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (24).
questions.explanation_vi: so indicates a consequence.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (25).
questions.explanation_vi: build confidence is the correct collocation.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best word for blank (26).
questions.explanation_vi: plan + to-infinitive.

questions.stem_text: What is the best title of the passage?
options: The history of Green Hill School
questions.explanation_vi: It describes several ways young people help their community.

questions.stem_text: According to the passage, why did the pupils create a book corner?
options: To help younger children enjoy reading
written_answers: To help younger children enjoy reading
questions.explanation_vi: The book corner is explicitly intended for younger readers.

questions.stem_text: The word “them” in the passage refers to ______.
questions.explanation_vi: “them” refers to the younger children receiving reading support.

questions.stem_text: Which activity did the pupils NOT do?
questions.explanation_vi: Wall painting is not mentioned.

questions.stem_text: The word “encouraged” is CLOSEST in meaning to ______.
questions.explanation_vi: Encouraged means supported or motivated.

questions.stem_text: What can be inferred from the passage?
options: Only adults can improve a neighbourhood.
Projects succeed only with large budgets.
Working together can make small projects valuable.
Children should stop spending time on hobbies.
written_answers: Working together can make small projects valuable.
questions.explanation_vi: The passage stresses teamwork and modest but meaningful projects.

questions.stem_text: What does Notice A mean?
options: You may enter the garden at any time.
You may help with gardening after signing up.
Only teachers can work in the garden.
The garden is closed for the whole month.
written_answers: You may help with gardening after signing up.
questions.explanation_vi: The notice asks learners to register before joining.

questions.stem_text: According to Notice B, students ______.
options: may keep books for another month
should leave books in the classroom
questions.explanation_vi: Books are due by Friday.

questions.stem_text: What does Sign C mean?
options: Running is allowed in the corridor.
Students must walk in the corridor.
Only teachers may use the corridor.
The corridor is closed for repairs.
written_answers: Students must walk in the corridor.
questions.explanation_vi: NO RUNNING means walking only.

questions.stem_text: According to Notice D, ______.
options: the event is on Saturday morning
written_answers: the event is on Saturday morning
questions.explanation_vi: The notice gives a Saturday morning schedule.

questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Tom likes drawing more than playing computer games.”
options: Tom prefers playing computer games to drawing.
Tom is not interested in drawing.
Tom prefers drawing to playing computer games.
written_answers: Tom prefers drawing to playing computer games.
questions.explanation_vi: prefer A to B is equivalent to like A more than B.

questions.stem_text: Which sentence is correctly formed from “We / decide / plant / trees / last weekend”?
options: We decided planting trees last weekend.
We decide to plant trees last weekend.
We decided to planting trees last weekend.
We decided to plant trees last weekend.
written_answers: We decided to plant trees last weekend.
questions.explanation_vi: decide + to V; past simple decided.

questions.stem_text: Which order makes the paragraph most logical?
questions.explanation_vi: First her usual materials, then a recent example, finally the benefit.

questions.stem_text: Choose the best sentence to end the paragraph in Question 39.
options: Therefore, everyone must give up outdoor hobbies.
In short, hobbies can bring both pleasure and useful skills.
For this reason, Hoa never shares her work with anyone.
However, her friends do not know what hobbies are.
written_answers: In short, hobbies can bring both pleasure and useful skills.
questions.explanation_vi: B summarises the positive effects of hobbies.
